title: DRY RUN (laptop path check, reduced size): Campaign 33 token C2_ECHO (class 2): I-ECHO on IBM-T0

criteria.name: S1 the run happened on the requested device
S2 wall time inside the walltime budget
criteria.threshold: <= min(walltime 3600 s, 3600 s) and <= 1.1 x budget + 120 s

criteria.name: S3 telemetry and run block present
criteria.threshold: every policy field non-null on the CI; present on the laptop

criteria.name: S4 every seed and every chunk recorded
S5 no out-of-memory retry left unrecorded
S6 (dry run) every unit sampled; any budget reduction recorded (the full-plan check is the CI's)

seeds.rule: aer seed of chunk i of circuit c = s0 * 1e4 + c * 1e6 + i * stride, stride = chunk size, s0 = 33 000 000 + 1e5 x token index (prompts/33 2.3 s0; the circuit/chunk offsets are widened from 1e3 c so that circuits, chunks, tokens and the a/b halves are disjoint for <= 1e6 shots per circuit: the literal s0 + 1e3 c + i stride overlaps above 1000 shots per circuit)

dry_run_reductions.reason: a laptop path check, not a result: shots x 0.01 (prompts/33 A4), <= 16 shots per run() call, at most 4 circuits per sector, and at most 32 shots per circuit / unit -- noisy 20-21-qubit Aer runs at several seconds per shot on this CPU (the 1-shot warm-up of C4_F8_B0a took 52 s under load), so a 0.01-scaled plan of record (up to 676 shots for C4_F1_B1) would not fit the 10-minute dry-run bound

data.shots_reason: target 1e5 per circuit, fitted to the budget at 61.45 s/shot (validation/dryrun/C2_CAL.json: kraus/cpu at None s/shot); dry run: 1 shot per run (path check)

f_hit_kappa_0.82.estimator: (sum n_ref - sum N a / dim) / (sum N p_ref readout_factor); Poisson (Garwood) interval on the pooled count

f0_twirled.rule: identity weight of the Pauli twirl of every gate error and delay window, x readout survival

channel_classes: thermal relaxation T1/T2 on every gate for its duration
thermal relaxation on every explicit delay (idle-aware)
noise.source: data/hardware/K0_prep/ibm_kingston_full_20261006T0652Z.json through NoiseModel.from_backend on a target built from the record (no fake provider); qiskit_aer NoiseModel.from_backend docs (read 2026-10-06)
noise.pta_rule: p_X = p_Y = (1 - e^{-t/T1})/4, p_Z = (1 - e^{-t/T2})/2 - (1 - e^{-t/T1})/4 on delays; every gate error twirled numerically (sum_k |Tr P K_k|^2 / d^2)

data.class2_channels: depolarizing + T1/T2 relaxation (gates; delays in idle-aware cells) + readout
data.note: class 2 gives consistency with the K1 measurement and the K0/K1 analytic numbers; no f point value is claimed (at f ~ 1e-5, 1e5 shots give ~1 expected hit)

run.parallel_efficiency_note: one task: E(p) needs T_1 and T_p from two task counts (not measured)

physics_criteria_information_dry_run.name: P6 decoder round trip on every accepted string
P7 simulated accepted counts and reference hits reported with the two-sided Poisson probability of the measured K1 values (58 / 45 accepted, 0 / 0 hits at 1e5)

dry run: one circuit (B0_ref117_k1) per T2 convention (the CI runs both K1 circuits)
